name: Muime

attributes.attribute: a double-eye sprite of good and bad omen
a bad omen far from home, a kind spirit near home
the echo of the old weight of the foster mother

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Muime is a figure of Scottish folk belief. Her name means stepmother, nurse, or wet nurse. In the tales she is a double eye figure, a sprite who at times brings good luck and at times its opposite. To meet her while far from home was a very bad omen. To meet her near home was to find a helpful spirit. The figure carries the echo of an old Celtic custom, when the foster mother held a place of great honor and trust in the life of her land.
